page.layout: One column of numbered questions, each with a page reference at its right end. Left edge: a strip of the neighbouring page, not transcribed. Faint show-through below the list, not transcribed.

main_text.l: 7. Utrum Protestantes sint hæretici vel schismatici: an verò Romani pontifi-cii? pag.149.
8. Quæ sit tutissima cum pontificiis disputandi, eosque convincendi ratio? pag.163
9. Quinam possint judicare controversias theologicas. p.167
10. Unde certò confirmentur pii de religionis Christianæ capitibus. p.169
11. An pastores & doctores Protestantiū sint legitimis Dei servis annumerandi. p.171
12. An præsules Romani sint habendi in numero fidorum Dei servorum? pag. 195
13. An miracula Romanensium demonstrent illorum ecclesiam esse verâ Christi sponsam? p.213
14. Quæ sit tutissima via promovendi pacem & concordiam ecclesiarum? pag. 223.

page.notes: Printed "Protestantiū" carries a macron over the final u, kept as printed. Number "9." reads "controversias" as printed "controversi-as" with hyphen at line end. The page number, running head, catchword and signature are not visible on this scan. Items 7 and 8 are read with moderate confidence where the ink is faint.
